findings.description: The CMK is created without enable_key_rotation, so it defaults to false and the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the impact of key compromise and violates CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark control for KMS key rotation.

No policy attribute is defined, so AWS applies the default key policy that delegates full control of the key to the account root, allowing any IAM principal in the account with sufficient IAM permissions to use or manage this logs-encryption key. An explicit least-privilege key policy should scope usage to the logging services and administrators that require it.
